info.title: EKZ M&E System API
info.description: Backend API for the Ekiti Knowledge Zone Monitoring & Evaluation System. Tracks programme performance through a logframe hierarchy, collects field data via mobile-friendly forms, and visualises progress through dashboards and GIS maps.
